info.accrualExplanationPrefix: The accrual type decides how the scheduled job credits the quota:
info.accrualExplanationSuffix: means each run adds the accrual amount to every eligible employee's balance. Pro-rata prorates a mid-period joiner's first period, so someone who joins halfway through a month is credited half of it rather than all of it.

noLeaveTypes: No leave types yet — create one on the Leave types tab first. A policy has to attach to a type.

applicableAfterDays.label: Applicable after (days of service)
applicableAfterDays.description: Blank means it applies from the joining date.

proRata.label: Pro-rata for mid-period joiners
proRata.description: Off means a joiner gets the full period's accrual on their first run, however few days of it they worked.

errors.saveFailed: Could not save the leave policy.

validation.leaveTypeRequired: Pick the leave type this policy governs
validation.annualQuotaRequired: Enter the annual quota in days
validation.accrualTypeRequired: Pick how the quota is credited
validation.accrualAmountRequired: Enter how many days each period credits
validation.effectiveFromRequired: A policy needs a start date
validation.endBeforeStart: The end date cannot be before the start date
